companyFieldUpdates.name: Skyway Concession Company LLC
companyFieldUpdates.description: Skyway Concession Company LLC is the concessionaire and operator of the Chicago Skyway, a 7.8-mile, six-lane toll road linking Chicago's Dan Ryan Expressway with the Indiana Toll Road. The company operates, maintains and tolls the facility under a 99-year concession that began on January 26, 2005 and runs to January 2104. Atlas Arteria owns 66.67% after acquiring the former CPP Investments and OMERS interests on December 1, 2022; Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan retains 33.33% from the 2016 pension-consortium acquisition. The City of Chicago and the roadway are not separate PortCos, and upstream holding entities are ownership vehicles. No signed pending sale or later ownership change was identified through August 19, 2026.
